contenders.handicapper_notes: Top selection with Class Drop Elevator applied, dropping from Saturday Metro Class 3 at Eagle Farm (beaten 4.2L, 11 days ago) to Wednesday Metro Class 3. Canonical style 'S' (midpack swooper) under standard pace with three 'E' runners ensuring honest tempo. Strong Soft-track specialist (2 wins, 1 placing from 4 starts) who crushed Vermilion Kirin by 6.3L two back; 57.5kg with Ben Thompson from barrier 5 offsets the +9m Conveyor Belt rail bias.

Primary danger. Canonical style 'E' who maps to control or share the fence from barrier 3 (sliding inward after scratches) on a +9m Doomben rail favoring on-pace inside runners. Drops from Saturday BM70/BM80 company (missed by a head in Doomben BM80 two back), though excluded from class-drop bonus after tiring 6.1L on Heavy ground last start. Carries 60.0kg topweight tax on Soft 5 and drops back from 2200m to 2000m, keeping him just behind Peccavi despite Angela Jones aboard.

Flagged as Danger Horse at generous odds. Canonical style 'E' drawn the coveted barrier 1 pole on a +9m Conveyor Belt rail at Doomben's tight 1715m oval. Backs up off a gutsy all-the-way Soft-track Class 1 win at Sunshine Coast 10 days ago and carries just 56.0kg. If he holds the rail cleanly behind or alongside Taravia, the track-bias edge makes him a major threat to stick on for a top-three finish.

Consistent mare with canonical style 'P' who handles Soft ground well and carries a featherweight 55.0kg (further aided by Olivia Kendal's claim). Solid fourth in Ipswich Class 3 last start after a close second in Class 2 prior, and owns solid Doomben 2000m form. Outside barrier 9 on a +9m rail is the main obstacle, forcing her to work to find midfield cover around the first bend.

Doomben and 2000m track-distance winner with strong Soft-track credentials (3 wins, 3 placings). Canonical style 'P' maps for a textbook box-seat stalk from barrier 4 behind the leaders on the +9m rail. Rebounded with a close second at Gold Coast last start, though he carries 59.0kg and was soundly beaten 6.3L by Peccavi two starts back at Eagle Farm.

Canonical style 'P' stalker who picks up top Doomben jockey Ryan Maloney at 57.0kg. Scored back-to-back Sunshine Coast wins (including Soft ground) before two plain efforts on Heavy at Eagle Farm and Synthetic at Gold Coast after awkward starts. Barrier 8 is sticky on the +9m rail, requiring a clean jump to slot into a trailing spot.
